text: Charter's signed, kickoff done. Reminder for everyone: yield, cost and dates are all still soft. Please don't quote the early numbers as if they're locked.

Comms wants a headline jobs number for the community brief. Finance gave me a developer-wide best case ~1,200. Using it for now but flagging I'm not 100% comfortable it's a Marrowbank-specific, local number.
Caveat it heavily then. That 1,200 is gross, whole-build, not net local. If it comes back to bite us at consultation that's on us.
Appraisal's pointing hard at the AT-15. 47 machines vs 58, better LCOE. Only thing holding me back is whether Aeolus can actually deliver the 15s in our window.
Aeolus came back — AT-15 slots available for our window. That clears it. Switching the basis to AT-15.
Northwind's intertidal screening on Saltmarsh Point is bad. The corridor clips the SSSI saltmarsh. I don't think we can consent a cable trench through it. Looking hard at Drover's Gap instead.
Drover's Gap is fine for the onshore route to my end, roughly same cable length. If it unblocks consent, do it.

Separately — the draft bird chapter has kittiwake collisions around 120/yr, low significance on our avoidance rate. I'd brace for the Bird Trust to come back with a far higher number on a more precautionary rate.

Called it. Marrow Bird Trust submission is in — they've got kittiwake collisions at ~600/yr, high significance, formal objection. Six times ours. It's the avoidance-rate assumption doing all the work.
Heads up before it's official: NGESO is going to give us an accelerated offer — Marrow Bank substation, 2030 instead of Calder 2031. A year earlier and a better point of connection.

Folding everything into the model. CAPEX is going to land at £2.65bn, not the £2.4bn in the October deck — the AT-15 change, Drover's Gap, the Marrow Bank connection and contingency. The deck number is stale, please stop quoting it.
And COD is 2030 now, not 2029 — grid pulled us earlier, consent pushed us later, nets to 2030. Revised programme is the record.
I'm going to have to walk back the 1,200 jobs number publicly. Can't substantiate it for Marrowbank. ~300 construction FTE is what I can defend; O&M jobs genuinely TBD. Correcting the brief.
FID board tomorrow. AT-15, £2.65bn, COD 2030, conservative energy case. We go in honest about the bird objection and the jobs walk-back. Thank you all — three years of work.
